params.name: headline
params.default: { DatePickerDefaults.DatePickerHeadline(selectedDateMillis = state.selectedDateMillis, displayMode = state.displayMode, dateFormatter = dateFormatter, modifier = Modifier.padding(DatePickerHeadlinePadding), contentColor = colors.headlineContentColor,) }

doc.state: state of the date picker. See [rememberDatePickerState].
doc.modifier: the [Modifier] to be applied to this date picker
doc.dateFormatter: a [DatePickerFormatter] that provides formatting skeletons for dates display
doc.colors: [DatePickerColors] that will be used to resolve the colors used for this date picker in different states. See [DatePickerDefaults.colors].
doc.colors.containerColor: the color used for the date picker's background
doc.colors.titleContentColor: the color used for the date picker's title
doc.colors.headlineContentColor: the color used for the date picker's headline
doc.colors.weekdayContentColor: the color used for the weekday letters
doc.colors.subheadContentColor: the color used for the month and year subhead labels that appear when months are displayed at a `DateRangePicker`.
doc.colors.navigationContentColor: the content color used for the year selection menu button and the months arrow navigation when displayed at a `DatePicker`.
doc.colors.yearContentColor: the color used for a year item content
doc.colors.disabledYearContentColor: the color used for a disabled year item content
doc.colors.currentYearContentColor: the color used for the current year content when selecting a year
doc.colors.selectedYearContentColor: the color used for a selected year item content
doc.colors.disabledSelectedYearContentColor: the color used for a disabled selected year item content
doc.colors.selectedYearContainerColor: the color used for a selected year item container
doc.colors.disabledSelectedYearContainerColo: the color used for a disabled selected year item container
doc.colors.dayContentColor: the color used for days content
doc.colors.disabledDayContentColor: the color used for disabled days content
doc.colors.selectedDayContentColor: the color used for selected days content
doc.colors.disabledSelectedDayContentColor: the color used for disabled selected days content
doc.colors.selectedDayContainerColor: the color used for a selected day container
doc.colors.disabledSelectedDayContainerColor: the color used for a disabled selected day container
doc.colors.todayContentColor: the color used for the day that marks the current date
doc.colors.todayDateBorderColor: the color used for the border of the day that marks the current date
doc.colors.dayInSelectionRangeContentColor: the content color used for days that are within a date range selection
doc.colors.dayInSelectionRangeContainerColor: the container color used for days that are within a date range selection
doc.colors.dividerColor: the color used for the dividers used at the date pickers
doc.colors.dateTextFieldColors: the [TextFieldColors] defaults for the date text field when in [DisplayMode.Input]. See [OutlinedTextFieldDefaults.colors].
doc.title: the title to be displayed in the date picker
doc.headline: the headline to be displayed in the date picker
doc.showModeToggle: indicates if this DatePicker should show a mode toggle action that transforms it into a date input
doc.focusRequester: a focus requester that will be used to focus the text field when the date picker is in an input mode. Pass `null` to not focus the text field if that's the desired behavior.
